subagent_model: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), as self-reported by each of the 18 subagents
notes: One fresh general-purpose subagent per pair (18 in total, run in parallel), each given the full text of RULES.md plus its pair's rubric, report and output paths. The coordinator did not read, grade or change any verdicts. The first validator run passed with 0 errors and 2 warnings: _meta.json was missing (since fixed), and P02 line 31 is Satisfied on criterion 9 with no evidence quote. That criterion is negative and its wording is 'does not include', so the verdict rests on something being absent. Warnings were left as they are. Deviations reported by subagents: (1) P04's grader ran one text search across the whole reports/ directory instead of only its two reports. It reports that the output listed other filenames and matched words, that it opened none of those files, and that none of it affected a verdict. (2) P16's grader checked JSON escaping and quotes by hand rather than with a parser; the validator later passed the file. Reading differences between pairs that share a rubric, left as graded: Q2 criterion 5 ('fully supported') was read as a threshold in P17 (Not Satisfied for both reports) but not in P01 (Partially Satisfied for both). Q5 criterion 4 ('fails to define any technical term') was read as 'defines no term at all' in P04, P12 and P16, so both reports in each pair are Not Satisfied. The branch check ran 'git fetch origin', which downloaded the origin/codex branch ref; its contents were never opened or read.
